name: Point-Based Light Transport in Participating Media
aliases: Point-Based Global Illumination in Participating Media
Point-Based Global Illumination for Participating Media
Point-Based Light Transport for Participating Media with Refractive Boundaries
PBGI for homogeneous media with refractive boundaries
definition: A rendering method for homogeneous participating media enclosed in refractive boundaries that computes single, double, and multiple scattering effects using precomputed light surface and volume samples, handling refraction at boundaries which breaks screen-space coherence.
summary: Point-Based Light Transport in Participating Media is a global illumination method for homogeneous translucent materials with refractive boundaries that decorrelates scene complexity by replacing the scene with a shaded point cloud for indirect illumination.
